name: Hariyali Paneer
ingredients: ½ cup each coriander and mint leaves
½ tsp cumin seeds and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Blend the spinach, coriander, mint, chillies, garlic and ginger with a little water to a smooth green purée.
Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the purée and cook on medium heat for 5 minutes. Take off the heat and whisk in the yogurt.
Return to low heat, add the paneer and ¼ cup water, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Finish with garam masala, salt and lemon juice.
note: The green purée is rich in iron and folate; do not boil after adding the yogurt.
